scale: 1 poor to 5 strong; final threshold 4 on every required category

structural_reference_fidelity.reason: Broad saddle beam, paired canisters, diagonal shoulders, six feeds, paired external actuators, emblem, chamber and flared hollow bell follow the independently inspected Thetazine source. Fine source plate/engraving detail is simplified.

construction_and_supported_fittings.reason: Rear and clay views show a supported two-foot structure, continuous supply routing, hollow bell and retaining ribs; 82 listed mounting heads contact supports. This is not exhaustive intersection proof.

surfacing.reason: Shared cast/tank/brass/bell maps remain technically valid and directionally appropriate. The smooth broad plates and sparse weathering do not yet match the denser legacy construction detail; finish is below final threshold.

source_state_fidelity.reason: Two idle and two run source references were inspected, but changing flame/plume shapes have not been modeled or captured. Candidate contains light controls only.

model_interface.reason: Actual imported standard flanges remain at +/-2.5,1,.36, feet at Z0; analytical draw fit only. Native pipe-mouth/cap acceptance remains explicitly open.

decision: Keep separately editable v01-candidate; do not install or mark model family done. Repair source plate/surface fidelity and capture source state/flame layers before native graphics promotion.
